race.comment: GALWAY SHAWL (3) sets the standard after resuming in Saturday company at Belmont Park, where she began slowly, made ground and was beaten just under two lengths by Pingers without having much luck. Back in grade now and should get things to suit off the inside barrier. Can return to winning ways second-up. SCREAM (6) is the main threat off two trial wins in readiness for his return. He dipped at the end of last campaign, but his form prior was sound and he carries no weight in this event. Fresh record is a query but he can give a bold sight. QUEEN ARIA (5) comes here first-up without a trial, though the booking of Pike suggests she's on song for her return. Maps to get every chance from the draw and she can't be left out. BONDITRAM (4) is race fit and has placed at both runs this campaign. Building nicely and can play a role. BLUE CAN TALK (7) is better than she's shown in her past couple and can bounce back.
